title: First Knight
description: King Arthur (Sean Connery) loves Guinevere (Julia Ormond) and tries to keep her from the clutches of Lancelot (Richard Gere) and a land-grabber.

title: No Mercy
description: A Chicago detective (Richard Gere) flees through a bayou, handcuffed to the Cajun mistress (Kim Basinger) of a ponytailed crime lord (Jeroen Krabbé).

title: Talhotblond
description: Thomas meets a beautiful teenager online, with whom he engages in a nearly two-year romance over the Internet until she learns the truth about him, which leads Thomas to exact the ultimate revenge.

title: Darkness Falls
description: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.

title: The Fog
description: Residents (Tom Welling, Maggie Grace, Selma Blair) of a seaside community fall prey to malevolent entities hidden within the thick mist around their homes.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
description: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant longer life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.

title: Straw Dogs
description: A screenwriter (James Marsden) and his wife (Kate Bosworth) are pushed into a violent confrontation with locals after they move to the woman's Mississippi hometown for the summer.

title: The Principal
description: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up.

title: Stealing Harvard
description: A nitwit (Tom Green) persuades his down-to-earth friend (Jason Lee) to commit robbery to pay for college tuition.

title: Swept Away
description: While boating from Greece to Italy, a wealthy woman (Madonna) and a sailor (Adriano Giannini) become stranded on a desert island.

title: The Ugly Truth
description: An uptight television producer takes control of a morning show segment on modern relationships hosted by a misogynistic man.

title: The Cable Guy
description: An act of kindness brings a jilted architect the unwanted friendship of an unbalanced cable-TV installer.

title: Julie & Julia
description: A woman in Queens, N.Y., sets a deadline of one year to prepare all 524 recipes in Julia Child's famous cookbook, "Mastering the Art of French Cooking."

title: Peggy Sue Got Married
description: A 1985 housewife (Kathleen Turner) passes out at her high-school reunion and wakes up in 1960, in school with her husband-to-be (Nicolas Cage).

title: The Princess and the Marine
description: A Marine has a forbidden romance with a Muslim Bahraini princess and sneaks her to the United States to marry her.

title: Private Valentine: Blonde & Dangerous
description: Popular actress Megan Valentine joins the Marines and is sent to boot camp, where she butts heads with gruff Sgt. Louisa Morley and struggles to adapt to life without luxury.

title: Songs in Ordinary Time
description: In a small Vermont town during the early 1960s, a single mother of three finds love with a drifter who is not what he seems.

title: Calendar Girl
description: Three Nevada high-school graduates (Jason Priestley, Gabriel Olds, Jerry O'Connell) fulfill their dream date with Marilyn Monroe in 1962 Hollywood.

title: Finding Graceland
description: A man (Johnathon Schaech) meets a Marilyn Monroe impersonator (Bridget Fonda) while traveling with an aging hitchhiker (Harvey Keitel) who thinks he is Elvis.

title: Best of the Best
description: Five American martial artists prepare to battle the South Korean champions in the 1988 Seoul Summer Olympics.

title: Facing the Giants
description: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: A struggling salesman takes custody of his son as he's poised to begin a life-changing professional career.

title: Roman J. Israel, Esq.
description: Roman J. Israel is an idealistic defense attorney who joins another law firm after the death of his boss and mentor. Israel's legacy of activism soon gets put to the test when he takes on the case of Langston Bailey, a young man accused of murder.

title: The Natural
description: The almost mythical ability of a middle-aged baseball player rockets a major-league team toward the 1939 pennant.

title: Suspect
description: A Washington lobbyist (Dennis Quaid) on jury duty helps a public defender (Cher) save a deaf-mute vagrant (Liam Neeson) accused of murder.

title: Blue Thunder
description: A Los Angeles police pilot (Roy Scheider) commandeers a helicopter equipped with snooping gadgets and trick weapons.

title: First Knight
description: King Arthur (Sean Connery) loves Guinevere (Julia Ormond) and tries to keep her from the clutches of Lancelot (Richard Gere) and a land-grabber.

title: Godzilla
description: Nuclear testing in the South Pacific produces a giant mutated lizard that wreaks havoc upon New York City.

title: The Karate Kid
description: A New Jersey teen moves to California, meets bullies and learns karate from a handyman, Mr. Miyagi.

title: The Karate Kid Part II
description: Mr. Miyagi returns to Okinawa with his karate student and meets an old foe's challenge to a duel.

title: The Karate Kid Part III
description: Mr. Miyagi and his student open a bonsai-tree shop, then fight thugs sent by a millionaire toxic-waste dumper.

title: A Knight's Tale
description: An English commoner (Heath Ledger) dons the armor of a dead jouster and, with the help of friends (Mark Addy, Paul Bettany, Alan Tudyk), competes against nobles in 14th-century France.

title: Julie & Julia
description: A woman in Queens, N.Y., sets a deadline of one year to prepare all 524 recipes in Julia Child's famous cookbook, "Mastering the Art of French Cooking."

title: Lake Placid
description: A New York paleontologist (Bridget Fonda) goes to the backwoods of Maine and teams up with the local game warden (Bill Pullman) to stop a 35-foot killer crocodile.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
description: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant longer life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.

title: The Lazarus Project
description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

title: Lost & Found
description: To rebuild their family fortune, teenage brothers hunt for treasure while spending the summer on a remote island.

title: The Last Dragonslayer
description: A young orphan girl (Ellise Chappell), indentured servant to a magician, discovers that she's destined to become the last dragonslayer in a world with only one remaining dragon.

title: Alpha
description: Left for dead, a Cro-Magnon teen forms an unlikely alliance with a lone wolf that was abandoned by its pack. Facing overwhelming odds and nonstop danger, the boy and the wolf must now trek through a harsh landscape to make it home before winter.
